—秦书简从程安的世界里消失了。程安意识到这个事实的时候，已经是高考结束五天后。他发了疯一样的找了两天两夜，终于明白，她走了。秦书简走了。不要他了。他的小简单，不要他了。…高考最后一场英语考试，结束的时候是下午5点。程安从教室外面的储物柜里拿出手机开机，就看见了父亲程统一发来的信息。定居英国的表姑妈去世，程统一公司这几天太忙抽不出时间去参加葬礼，他又不舍得娇妻一个人跑那么远，于是这个任务就果断落在了马上要高考完的程安身上，司机已经等在校门口，晚上7点的飞机，让程安考试结束后，就立刻跟司机联系。程安看到消息，脸都绿了。从他们学校到机场都要将近1个小时，现在已经5点10分了，他至少是要提前半个小时到机场。所以现在留给他的时间还不到20分钟。他原本想着今晚终于能把小简单拐去酒店了，可现在这个计划是彻底的泡汤了。恰好此时，司机的电话也打了进来。程安接过电话说了两句，就匆忙挂断了。然后快走几步，抓起刚走到教室门口的秦书简的手，就飞快的朝着教学楼后面跑去。秦书简胆战心惊的被他拽着跑了五分钟，然后被他按在了小树林的树上。两人都微微喘息着，秦书简还来不及出声问他做什么，他就一只手扣住了她的后脑勺，低头堵住了她的唇。程安吻了许久才放开她，将她扣在怀里，唇角轻蹭着她的耳垂问：“想我没有？”自从生日那晚之后，这一个多月，只要有机会独处，他就忍不住想要抱抱她，亲亲她，他把今天晚上的酒店都定好了，……想到这里，程安呼吸都沉了沉，他轻吻着她的耳垂，下巴，鼻尖，最后唇角在她眼角碰了碰。然后发现秦书简呆呆的看着他，跟傻了似的。他翘了下唇角，忍不住从喉咙里发出了一声浅浅的低笑，“小笨蛋，你是不是没考好？”秦·小笨蛋·书简，腾的一下子红了脸。她动了动唇，正想要说什么，但是想到自己决心要走的事情，她脸上的热度就渐渐冷却下来，也不知道怎的，突然间有点难过。她垂了眸子，低低应了一声，“嗯。”程安唇角在她眉心碰了碰，然后腾出一只手捏了捏她的脸，轻笑着说：“考不好也没关系，我考的好。”往后我养你。秦书简轻眨了下眼睛，没明白他考得好跟她有什么关系，但是她现在也没心思想这些了。今天之后，她再也不是他的小丫鬟了。他们再也没有关系了。可明明是她求之不得的事情，但到了这个时候，不知怎的她竟然会觉得难以呼吸，心脏抽痛，鼻尖也微微泛酸。程安看到她突然间眼角都红了，心想着这小笨蛋大概是真的没考好，太难过了。他想好好安慰她一番，但是时间来不及了，只能又亲了亲她，温声说着，“我有事要出去两三天，今天周二，周六下午2点，我们在你家附近那个咖啡店见，好不好？”秦书简下意识的想说“好”，但是骗人的话这个时候不知怎的就是说不出口，她望着眼前这个令她明明十分惧怕的少年，心底却莫名的烧起了火，烧的她心脏滚烫滚烫的，第一次，她冲动的仰起头，笨拙的吻上了他的唇。

—Qin Shujian disappeared from Cheng An’s world. When Cheng An realized this fact, it was already five days after the college entrance examination. He searched frantically for two days and two nights, and finally understood that she was gone. Qin Shujian left. Don't want him anymore. His little simplicity, don't let him go. ...The last English test of the college entrance examination ends at 5 pm. Cheng An took out his mobile phone from the locker outside the classroom and turned it on, and saw the message from his father Cheng Tongyi. The cousin's aunt who settled in the UK passed away. Cheng Tongyi's company was too busy these days to take time to attend the funeral. He was not willing to let his beloved wife travel so far alone, so this task fell decisively on Cheng An, who was about to finish the college entrance examination. The driver was already waiting at the school gate. The flight was at 7 o'clock in the evening. Cheng An should contact the driver immediately after the exam. Cheng An's face turned green when he saw the news. It took nearly an hour to get from their school to the airport. It was already 5:10, so he had to get to the airport at least half an hour early. So now there is less than 20 minutes left for him. He originally thought that he could finally take Xiao Jian to the hotel tonight, but now this plan was completely ruined. Just at this time, the driver's phone also came in. Cheng An took the phone, said a few words, and hung up in a hurry. Then he walked a few steps quickly, grabbed Qin Shujian's hand who had just reached the classroom door, and ran quickly towards the back of the teaching building. Qin Shujian was frightened and dragged by him for five minutes, and then he pushed him against a tree in the grove. Both of them were panting slightly. Before Qin Shujian could ask him what he was doing, he clasped the back of her head with one hand and lowered his head to cover her lips. Cheng An kissed her for a long time before letting her go. He held her in his arms, brushed her earlobe with his lips and asked, "Did you miss me?" Since his birthday night, for more than a month, whenever he had the chance to be alone, he couldn't help but want to hug her and kiss her. He had booked a hotel for tonight... Thinking of this, Cheng An's breathing became heavy. He gently kissed her earlobe, chin, tip of nose, and finally touched the corners of her eyes with his lips. Then he found Qin Shujian looking at him blankly, as if he was stupid. He raised the corners of his lower lips and couldn't help but let out a shallow chuckle from his throat, "Little fool, did you fail the test?" Qin, Little fool, wrote a letter, blushing suddenly. She moved her lips and was about to say something, but when she thought about what she was determined to leave, the heat on her face gradually cooled down, and for some reason, she suddenly felt a little sad. She lowered her eyes and responded in a low voice, "Yeah." Cheng An touched the corner of his lips between her eyebrows, then freed up a hand to pinch her face, and said with a chuckle: "It doesn't matter if you don't do well in the exam, I did well in the exam." I will support you from now on. Qin Shujian blinked slightly, not understanding what his success in the exam had to do with her, but she didn't have the time to think about it now. After today, she is no longer his little maid. They have no relationship anymore. But it was obviously something she wanted, but at this time, she somehow found it difficult to breathe, her heart throbbed, and the tip of her nose was slightly sore. Cheng An saw the corners of her eyes suddenly turn red, thinking that this little fool probably really didn't do well in the exam, which was so sad. He wanted to comfort her, but it was too late, so he could only kiss her again and said softly, "I have to go out for two or three days for something. Let's meet at the coffee shop near your home at 2 pm today, Tuesday and Saturday, okay?" Qin Shujian subconsciously wanted to say "ok", but somehow he couldn't say the deceptive words at this time. SheLooking at the young man in front of her, who was obviously very afraid of her, an inexplicable fire burned in her heart, which made her heart boil. For the first time, she impulsively raised her head and kissed his lips awkwardly.
